messages:
maria: thinking out loud — we need a middle ground for debug sampling. idea: a proxied 'inspector' path that can persist full req/res for a tiny sampled set for SRE/SE troubleshooting, while analytics still only receives redacted payloads. questions: consent, TTL, console visibility?

devon: +1. implementation sketch: inspector-proxy accepts requests when route-level flag enabled. it writes an encrypted blob to storage and attaches an ephemeral token to console UI for authorized users. sampling is per-route or per-tenant. default sample_rate = 0.1% (0.001).

liam: cost note — raw payload retention + egress will balloon costs if folks accidentally enable it widely. need strong daily caps and global circuit breakers.

priya: from console-ux POV we should surface "sampling budget remaining" and an explicit warning modal when a team is about to exceed quota. one-click revoke for a tenant would be great.

zach: PII-first: prefer to avoid storing raw if possible. store masked payload + redaction map + HMAC id that lets us correlate events. unmasking should be rare and gated.

maria: HMAC/correlation is fine, but we need a breakglass path for hard bugs. propose: redaction map + masked blob encrypted with tenant KMS; unmask requires 2-person approval and is fully audited.

devon: ops knobs proposal (example):
```
inspector.sampling.rate=0.001
inspector.retention_hours=72
inspector.budget_daily=1000
inspector.breakglass.enabled=true
```

sdk-bot: quick config snippet for the config repo: 
```
inspector:
  sampling_rate: 0.001
  retention_hours: 72
  budget_daily: 1000
  breakglass:
    enabled: true
    approval_roles: ["security", "oncall"]
```

liam: telemetry events we need: inspector.sample_created, inspector.sample_viewed, inspector.breakglass_request, inspector.breakglass_granted. these should increment scoped quotas and hit billing/alerting.

priya: love the budget metric. console panels: per-tenant timeline of samples, anonymized tag cloud of fields dropped, and a "request heat" map so teams can see if sampling picks noisy endpoints.

zach: crypto detail — envelope-encrypt redaction maps with tenant KMS; rotate keys regularly. ensure no raw plaintext accessible to regular Redwood employees without breakglass approval.

oncall: operational constraint — breakglass must page the oncall rotation and only one active unmask per tenant at a time. also auto-revoke after TTL.

maria: rollout plan suggestion: internal-only canary (platform + SE) for 2 weeks, measure storage, sample_count, breakglass_calls. add dashboard panels: inspector.storage_bytes, inspector.sample_rate_actual, inspector.breakglass_count. if OK, flip to limited tenant opt-in.

devon: API change: add `X-Inspector-Optin: true` header for requests and a per-tenant console toggle that only admins can set. server-side guard to prevent accidental broad opt-ins.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to inspector-proxy cluster — tagging @devon @maria.

priya: created GH issue linking the UX mocks & acceptance criteria: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/7120 — will post mockups there.

maria: next steps: (1) devon + liam to draft quota/budget implementation, (2) zach to write encryption pattern doc, (3) priya to mock console panels, (4) oncall to write runbook for breakglass flow. schedule 30m sync after prototypes.
